Garage description
This paint is an exact replica of a giant python's skin. It also replicates the snake's properties of extreme elasticity, as well as its scaly texture.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
Paint first appeared on July 29, 2010.
Prior to the Paint Separation Update, Python was worth 50,500 crystals and could be bought from the rank of Third Lieutenant.
Legacy paint description:
A paint that helps shield your tank from Freeze and slightly reduces the damage inflicted by Shaft. Useful both in short and long-range battles. Makes your tank look as if it has been swallowed by a giant python.
